meta.title: Improve: Habit Tracker for iPhone
meta.desc: Improve is a habit tracker and planner in one. Finish your goals, earn trophies, and end every day with a bronze, silver or gold habit pal. Free on iPhone.
meta.og_title: Improve: Build habits. Earn a pal every day.
meta.og_desc: A habit tracker and planner in one. Earn a bronze, silver or gold habit pal every day.
hero.pill: A new habit pal every day
hero.h1: Build habits. Earn a pal every day.
hero.sub: Improve is a habit tracker and planner in one. Finish your goals, earn trophies, and end every day with a bronze, silver or gold habit pal. Free on iPhone.
store.aria: Download Improve on the App Store
tt.note: Opening from TikTok? TikTok blocks App Store links in its browser. Tap the ••• menu, choose Open in browser, then tap Download.
hero.quote: "The only habit app that has worked for me. Easy to set up, easy to use, and feels very rewarding."
hero.screen_alt: Improve home screen with today's habit pal and goals grouped by morning, day and evening
how.p: Tick off a few goals below and watch what happens. This is exactly how a day in Improve plays out.
demo.egg_alt: Today's habit pal, still an egg
demo.cap_silver_sub: Almost there. Gold is within reach.
steps.p1: Tag each goal Easy, Moderate or Challenging. Light days build the habit. Hard days earn gold.
steps.p2: Habits and to-dos both pay out, so every bit of progress counts toward tonight's pal.
steps.p3: Your pal joins the shelf based on how much you did, not whether you did everything. No pal is ever taken away.
reviews.q1: Been looking for something like this for a few years now. The simplicity of getting started and using it daily is why this is the only habit app that has worked for me. Easy to set up, easy to use, and feels very rewarding. The clean interface is a big bonus!
reviews.q2: Great app with a clean design and easy-to-use features. It's really helped me stay consistent with my daily routines and habits. Highly recommend!
reviews.q3: Excellent app for building and maintaining good habits! It's easy and well designed. I love being motivated to track my progress so clearly. Definitely one of the best habit trackers I've tried!
features.p: Recurring habits, a prioritized to-do list and everything due today, all in one calm view.
plans.h3: A busy mind breaks habits. Park everything here.
plans.p: Sort your to-dos by priority and knock them out. Bigger tasks pay more trophies, and everything you finish today feeds tonight's habit pal.
plans.alt: Plans screen with to-dos sorted into high, medium, low and to-do priorities
compare.p: Your sleep, steps, water and reading against real population data, with sources.
compare.l1: You get more daily steps than 78% of peopleSource: Bassett/Tudor-Locke international step counts
compare.l2: You get more sleep than 64% of peopleSource: CDC BRFSS, OECD Time Use
compare.l3: You spend 3.4x the average person's time on readingSource: American Time Use Survey
shelf.h3: One glance shows the year you built.
shelf.p: Every pal joins the shelf. Look back at your week, month or whole year and spot what's actually working.
streaks.p: Every day you earn a pal, your streak grows. Milestones go all the way to 1000 days.
friends.p: Add friends with a code and see their pals. When you both earn one on the same day, your shared streak grows.
health.p: Steps, calories, distance and other health habits fill in automatically. No typing required.
themes.p: Pick a palette that matches your mood, then switch between light, dark or automatic.
built.p: Goals sit in the part of the day you do them. Track counts, minutes or steps, set reminders, and choose from 100+ icons.
faq.q1: What happens if I miss a day?
faq.a1: Nothing is taken away. Your progress only ever moves forward. Every pal you earned stays on your shelf, and your streak simply starts again the next day you earn a pal.
faq.q2: Do I have to finish everything to earn a pal?
faq.a2: No. Your pal is based on how much you did, not whether you did everything. 30 trophies earns bronze, 60 silver and 90 gold.
faq.a3: Yes. Improve is free to download and use. Some features require an Improve Premium subscription, which you can find inside the app.
faq.a4: Improve is available for iPhone today.
faq.q5: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.a5: You can delete your account from Settings in the app at any time. You can also request deletion here.
final.p: Free on the App Store. Your first habit pal is waiting.
